spell.wizards.arcane_missile.description.name: Arcane Missiles
spell.wizards.arcane_missile.description.current: Channel 12 homing missiles, each dealing 26%% Arcane damage.
spell.wizards.arcane_missile.description.proposed: Channel 12 homing missiles, each dealing 26% Arcane damage.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.name: Improved Arcane Missiles
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.current: Arcane Missiles gains 10%% more spell power.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.name: Conjured Missile
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.current: Arcane Missiles fires 1 additional missile with every third channel hit, starting with the first. A full channel fires 4 extra missiles.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.proposed: Arcane Missiles fires 4 extra missiles during a full channel.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.name: Crippling Missiles
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.current: Arcane Missiles slows enemies by 10%% base movement speed per stack, up to 30%% at 3 stacks. Lasts 4s, refreshed by hits.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.proposed: Arcane Missiles slows enemies by 10% per stack, up to 30% for 4s.

spell.wizards.arcane_explosion.descripti.name: Arcane Explosion
spell.wizards.arcane_explosion.descripti.current: Create an explosion centered on the targeted enemy, dealing 260%% Arcane damage within 7 blocks before upgrades. Echoing Blast lowers the damage and resets the cooldown on a hit.
spell.wizards.arcane_explosion.descripti.proposed: Explode around your target, dealing 260% Arcane damage within 7 blocks.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.name: Improved Arcane Explosion
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.current: Arcane Explosion radius increases from 7 to 9 blocks around the targeted enemy.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.name: Echoing Blast
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.current: Arcane Explosion deals 160%% Arcane damage. Hitting an enemy resets its cooldown.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.proposed: Arcane Explosion deals 160% damage, but hitting an enemy resets its cooldown.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.name: Chain Detonation
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.current: Each Arcane Explosion hit causes another explosion after 0.5s, dealing 30%% Arcane damage.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_spel.proposed: Arcane Explosion causes another blast after 0.5s, dealing 30% Arcane damage.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_1_pass.name: Fissile Magic
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_1_pass.current: Explode for up to 40%% Arcane damage within 5 blocks, excluding the struck enemy. Damage decreases with distance.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_1_pass.proposed: Explode for up to 40% Arcane damage near the target, without hitting it again.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_1_pass.name: Arcane Radiance
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_1_pass.current: Restore health equal to 10%% Arcane power.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_1_pass.proposed: Heal for 10% of your Arcane power.

spell.wizards.arcane_beam.description.name: Arcane Beam
spell.wizards.arcane_beam.description.current: Channel 25 hits, each dealing 20%% Arcane damage. Consumes all Arcane Charges. Charged Beam changes the channel and damage.
spell.wizards.arcane_beam.description.proposed: Channel a beam that deals 20% Arcane damage per hit. Consumes all Arcane Charges.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel.name: Beam Exposure
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel.current: Beam hits apply Arcane Exposure for 3s: +4%% Arcane damage taken per level, up to 25 levels.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel.proposed: Beam hits make enemies take 4% more Arcane damage per stack, up to 100%, for 3s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel.name: Charged Beam
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel.current: Channel 50 hits. Damage grows from 10%% to 15%% Arcane power, gaining 0.15%% per hit. Beam width starts at 130%% and grows by 10%% per hit, up to 500%%.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel.proposed: Channel twice as long. The beam grows wider, and its damage rises from 10% to 15% per hit.

spell.wizards.arcane_barrage.description.name: Arcane Barrage
spell.wizards.arcane_barrage.description.current: Summon 3 Arcane Emitters that fire at your target or where you aim. Each lasts 6s. Bolts deal 40%% of the emitter's own Arcane power; emitter power grows with your Arcane power.
spell.wizards.arcane_barrage.description.proposed: Summon 3 emitters for 6s. They fire bolts at your target or aim, dealing 40% of their own Arcane power.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel.name: Improved Arcane Barrage
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel.current: Arcane Barrage emitters gain 10%% increased critical strike chance.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel.name: Attuned Emitters
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel.current: Arcane Emitters fire faster, matching your spell haste.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_spel.proposed: Arcane Emitters fire faster with spell haste.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_pass.name: Arcane Trap
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_pass.current: Leave a trap for 5s. Deals 40%% Arcane damage and applies Weakness II for 6s within 1.5 blocks.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_2_pass.proposed: Leave a trap that deals 40% Arcane damage and applies Weakness II for 6s.

spell.wizards.arcane_blink.description.name: Burst Blink
spell.wizards.arcane_blink.description.current: Blink forward up to 10 blocks before upgrades. Deal 50%% Arcane damage within 5 blocks at departure immediately and at arrival after 0.25s.
spell.wizards.arcane_blink.description.proposed: Blink forward and explode at both ends, dealing 50% Arcane damage at each location.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_4_spel.name: Improved Blink
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_4_spel.current: Increases Burst Blink distance by 5 blocks, to 15 blocks.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_4_spel.name: Purge
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_4_spel.current: Burst Blink grants Speed I (+20%% movement speed) for 4s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_4_spel.proposed: Burst Blink grants Speed I for 4s.

spell.wizards.arcane_evocation.descripti.name: Evocation
spell.wizards.arcane_evocation.descripti.current: Channel up to 10 stacks lasting 10s. Each grants +5%% base spell critical chance, +3%% spell haste and +10%% damage taken.
spell.wizards.arcane_evocation.descripti.proposed: Gain up to 10 stacks for 10s: 5% spell critical chance, 3% haste and 10% more damage taken per stack.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_4_spel.name: Improved Evocation
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_4_spel.current: Reduce Evocation's base cooldown by 5s, from 35 to 30s at full channel.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_4_spel.name: Rapid Evocation
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_4_spel.current: Evocation channels 12 times and can reach 12 stacks.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_4_spel.proposed: Evocation can build 12 stacks instead of 10.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_pass.name: Presence of Mind
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_pass.current: Ready your next Arcane spell for 5s. Its hits make enemies take 20%% more Arcane damage for 6s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_pass.proposed: Your next Arcane spell makes enemies take 20% more Arcane damage for 6s. Use within 5s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_pass.name: Arcane Ward
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_pass.current: Gain an absorption shield for 8s: 1 heart plus 1 heart per 5 Arcane power.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.arcane_tier_3_pass.proposed: Gain a shield for 8s. Your Arcane power makes it stronger.

spell.wizards.fire_breath.description.name: Fire Breath
spell.wizards.fire_breath.description.current: Breathe fire in front of you for 13%% Fire damage per hit, with no distance falloff.
spell.wizards.fire_breath.description.proposed: Breathe flames in front of you, dealing 13% Fire damage per hit.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_spell_.name: Explosive Breath
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_spell_.current: Fire Breath hits have a 10%% chance to trigger an explosion, dealing up to 30%% Fire damage within 2.5 blocks. Damage decreases with distance.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_spell_.proposed: Fire Breath hits have a 10% chance to explode for up to 30% Fire damage.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_spell_.name: Flame Throwing
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_spell_.current: Increase Fire Breath range by 4 blocks, from 8 to 12 blocks.

spell.wizards.fire_slash.description.name: Flame Slash
spell.wizards.fire_slash.description.current: Launch a wide wave of flame after a 0.1-second cast, dealing 100%% Fire damage to enemies in its path.
spell.wizards.fire_slash.description.proposed: Send out a wide wave of flame that deals 100% Fire damage.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_spell_.name: Improved Flame Slash
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_spell_.current: Increase Flame Slash range by 5 blocks.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_spell_.name: Wave after Wave
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_spell_.current: Flame Slash hits reduce its own remaining cooldown by 1s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_spell_.proposed: Flame Slash hits reduce its remaining cooldown by 1s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_1_passiv.name: Scorching Flames
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_1_passiv.current: Enemies take +4%% Fire damage per stack, up to 20%%. Lasts 2s; further applications refresh it.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_1_passiv.proposed: Enemies take 4% more Fire damage per stack, up to 20%, for 2s.

spell.wizards.fire_meteor.description.name: Meteor
spell.wizards.fire_meteor.description.current: Drop 3 meteors on the target. Each deals 150%% Fire damage within 6 blocks, with no distance falloff.
spell.wizards.fire_meteor.description.proposed: Drop 3 meteors on your target. Each deals 150% Fire damage in a 6-block blast.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.name: Improved Meteor
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.current: Reduce Meteor's base cooldown by 2s, from 20 to 18s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.name: Meteor Shower
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.current: Meteor drops 1 additional meteor, for 4 total.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.name: Meteor Splash
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.current: Meteor impacts create a burning area after 0.25s. It lasts 6s within 5 blocks, reaches 2 blocks high and deals 10%% Fire damage per hit.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.proposed: Meteor impacts leave burning ground for 6s, dealing 10% Fire damage per hit.

spell.wizards.fire_storm.description.name: Firestorm
spell.wizards.fire_storm.description.current: Channel flames around you, dealing 40%% Fire damage per hit within 15 blocks.
spell.wizards.fire_storm.description.proposed: Channel flames within 15 blocks, dealing 40% Fire damage per hit.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.name: Flame Whirlpool
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.current: Firestorm pulls enemies inward across its 15-block radius and applies Slowness II for 1s, refreshed on hit.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.proposed: Firestorm pulls enemies inward and slows them.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.name: Raging Firestorm
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.current: Firestorm hits 2 additional times and gains 100%% extra base knockback, pushing enemies away.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_spell_.proposed: Firestorm hits 2 extra times and knocks enemies away.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_passiv.name: Flame Trap
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_passiv.current: Leave a trap for 5s. Deals 30%% Fire damage and burns enemies for 4s within 1.5 blocks.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_2_passiv.proposed: Leave a trap that deals 30% Fire damage and burns enemies for 4s.

spell.wizards.fire_wall.description.name: Wall of Flames
spell.wizards.fire_wall.description.current: Place up to 4 walls within 5s. Each lasts 8s, deals 20%% Fire damage per hit and reaches 2 blocks high. The fourth wall or placement timeout starts the cooldown.
spell.wizards.fire_wall.description.proposed: Place up to 4 flame walls within 5s. Each lasts 8s and deals 20% Fire damage per hit.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_4_spell_.name: Improved Wall of Flames
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_4_spell_.current: Wall of Flames lasts 2s longer, for 10s total.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_4_spell_.name: Great Wall
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_4_spell_.current: Adds 2 wall segments. Segments have 1.2-block radius and 3-block height, and block living entities while active. Projectiles pass through.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_4_spell_.proposed: Flame walls grow wider and taller and gain 2 segments. They block players and mobs, but not projectiles.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_4_spell_.name: Healing Flames
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_4_spell_.current: Wall of Flames heals you and party allies for 0.5%% of your Fire power each hit.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_4_spell_.proposed: Flame walls heal you and party allies for 0.5% of your Fire power per hit.

spell.wizards.fire_hydra.description.name: Fire Hydra
spell.wizards.fire_hydra.description.current: Summon hydras for 20s (+5s with Improved Hydra)..

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_4_spell_.name: Hydra Brood
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_4_spell_.current: Conjures an additional Fire Hydra head.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_4_spell_.proposed: Summon one extra Fire Hydra head.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_passiv.name: Eruption
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_passiv.current: Explode for up to 30%% Fire damage within 5 blocks. Damage decreases with distance.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_passiv.proposed: Explode around you for up to 30% Fire damage.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_passiv.name: Flame Ward
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_passiv.current: Gain an absorption shield for 8s: 1 heart plus 1 heart per 10 Fire power. Attackers take 30%% Fire damage.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.fire_tier_3_passiv.proposed: Gain a shield for 8s that grows with your Fire power. Attackers take 30% Fire damage.

spell.wizards.frost_nova.description.name: Frost Nova
spell.wizards.frost_nova.description.current: Deal 180%% Frost damage to enemies within 10 blocks and freeze them for 2s before upgrades. Frozen enemies cannot move and are vulnerable to Frost magic.
spell.wizards.frost_nova.description.proposed: Deal 180% Frost damage within 10 blocks and freeze enemies for 2s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.name: Improved Frost Nova
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.current: Frost Nova freezes enemies for 0.5s longer, for 2.5s total.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.proposed: Frost Nova freezes enemies for 0.5s longer.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.name: Frost Splinters
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.current: Frost Nova hits cause secondary explosions, dealing 20%% Frost damage within 3 blocks.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.proposed: Frost Nova causes extra blasts that deal 20% Frost damage.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.name: Deep Freeze
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.current: Frost Nova applies 1 additional Frozen stack to each enemy.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.proposed: Frost Nova applies one extra Frozen stack.

spell.wizards.frost_spikes.description.name: Frost Spikes
spell.wizards.frost_spikes.description.current: Raise 8 frost spikes along an 8-block row before upgrades. Each hit deals 80%% Frost damage and freezes enemies for 2s. Frozen enemies cannot move and are vulnerable to Frost magic.
spell.wizards.frost_spikes.description.proposed: Raise a row of 8 ice spikes. Each hit deals 80% Frost damage and freezes enemies for 2s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.name: Improved Frost Spikes
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.current: Frost Spikes gains 10%% more spell power.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.name: Glacial Ridge
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.current: Frost Spikes raises 12 additional spikes, extending the row to 20 blocks.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.proposed: Frost Spikes raises 12 extra spikes, reaching 20 blocks.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.name: Frost Fan
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.current: Frost Spikes raises two additional rows at +/-10 degrees, dealing 25%% damage per hit with Improved Frost Spikes.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_spell.proposed: Frost Spikes adds two weaker side rows, each dealing 25% Frost damage per hit.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_1_passi.name: Winter's Chill
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_1_passi.current: Enemies take +8%% Frost critical damage per stack, up to 40%%. Lasts 2s; further applications refresh it.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_1_passi.proposed: Enemies take 8% more Frost critical damage per stack, up to 40%, for 2s.

spell.wizards.frost_shield.description.name: Frost Shield
spell.wizards.frost_shield.description.current: Block all incoming damage for 3s, with -100%% base movement speed. When the shield expires, freeze enemies within 5 blocks for 2s.
spell.wizards.frost_shield.description.proposed: Become immune to damage for 3s but move much slower. Freeze nearby enemies for 2s when the shield expires.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.name: Improved Frost Shield
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.current: Reduce Frost Shield's base cooldown by 3s, from 12 to 9s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.name: Nimble Shield
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.current: Gain 50%% base movement speed for 3s while using Frost Shield, offsetting half of its base movement penalty.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.proposed: Move faster while using Frost Shield, reducing its movement penalty.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.name: Durable Shield
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.current: Frost Shield lasts 1s longer, for 4s total.

spell.wizards.frost_lance.description.name: Ice Lance
spell.wizards.frost_lance.description.current: Launch an ice lance dealing 200%% Frost damage. Freezes hit enemies for 4s after a 0.5s delay.
spell.wizards.frost_lance.description.proposed: Launch an ice lance for 200% Frost damage. After a short delay, freeze enemies hit for 4s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.name: Improved Ice Lance
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.current: Reduce Ice Lance's base cooldown by 2s, from 12 to 10s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.name: Colossal Lance
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.current: Ice Lance is 50%% larger and gains +15%% critical chance.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.proposed: Ice Lance is 50% larger and gains 15% critical chance.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.name: Shattering Lance
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.current: Ice Lance stops at its first enemy. The direct hit retains 200%% damage and 4s delayed Frozen; its 8-block splash deals 50%% damage and 1s delayed Frozen without damage falloff.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_spell.proposed: Ice Lance keeps its direct hit but explodes on the first enemy, dealing 50% splash damage and freezing nearby enemies for 1s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_passi.name: Frost Trap
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_passi.current: Leave a trap for 5s. Freeze enemies within 1.5 blocks for 4s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_passi.proposed: Leave a trap that freezes nearby enemies for 4s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_passi.name: Arctic Reflex
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_passi.current: Your next Frost spell deals 20%% more damage. Use within 5s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_2_passi.proposed: Your next Frost spell deals 20% more damage. Use within 5s.

spell.wizards.frost_blizzard.description.name: Blizzard
spell.wizards.frost_blizzard.description.current: Rain frost shards on the target and nearby enemies. Each deals about 26.7%% Frost damage within 3 blocks and slows enemies. No distance falloff.
spell.wizards.frost_blizzard.description.proposed: Rain ice shards that damage and slow enemies around your target.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_4_spell.name: Improved Blizzard
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_4_spell.current: Blizzard hits 3 additional times, for 15 channel hits total.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_4_spell.name: Snow Storm
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_4_spell.current: Blizzard slows enemies by 20%% base movement speed per stack, up to 60%% at 3 stacks. Lasts 3s, refreshed by hits.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_4_spell.proposed: Blizzard hits slow enemies by 20% per stack, up to 60%, for 3s.

spell.wizards.frost_elemental.descriptio.name: Frost Elemental
spell.wizards.frost_elemental.descriptio.current: Summon a Frost Elemental for 20s. Its health, armor and melee damage grow with your Frost power. It has 20%% of your Frost power; its Frost Shard deals 100%% and Super Nova deals 180%% of its own power..
spell.wizards.frost_elemental.descriptio.proposed: Summon a Frost Elemental for 20s. Your Frost power strengthens its body and attacks.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_4_spell.name: Elemental Legion
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_4_spell.current: Summon three normal-sized Frost Elementals, each with 80%% of the base attributes. Each Super Nova reaches 6 blocks and freezes for 0.5s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_4_spell.proposed: Summon 3 Elementals, each with 80% of normal stats. Their novas freeze nearby enemies for 0.5s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_4_spell.name: Elemental Colossus
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_4_spell.current: Summon one Frost Colossus at 1.7x size with double base attributes, inheriting your knockback resistance.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_4_spell.proposed: Summon a larger Elemental with double stats and your knockback resistance.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_passi.name: Cold Snap
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_passi.current: Reset Frost spell cooldowns, except Blizzard and Frost Elemental.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_passi.proposed: Reset Frost spell cooldowns, except Blizzard and Frost Elemental.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_passi.name: Frost Ward
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_passi.current: Gain an absorption shield for 8s: 1 heart plus 1 heart per 10 Frost power. Slows attackers.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.frost_tier_3_passi.proposed: Gain a shield for 8s that grows with your Frost power. Slows attackers.

spell.archers.power_shot.description.name: Power Shot
spell.archers.power_shot.description.current: Prepares your next 3 arrows for 8s. Hits apply Hunter's Mark for 6s, refreshed, increasing damage taken by 7%% per stack, up to 21%%.
spell.archers.power_shot.description.proposed: Empower your next 3 arrows. Each hit marks enemies to take 7% more damage, stacking up to 21% for 6s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.name: Improved Power Shot
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.current: Power Shot prepares arrows for 10s instead of 8s. Hunter's Mark lasts 6s, refreshed by hits.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.name: Improved Hunter's Mark
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.current: Prepares 4 arrows instead of 3. Hunter's Mark stacks up to 4 times, increasing damage taken by 7%% per stack, up to 28%%.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.proposed: Power Shot prepares 4 arrows and lets Hunter's Mark reach 4 stacks.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.name: Charged Shot
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.current: Marked arrow hits deal 50%% of your Ranged Damage as splash to other enemies within 5 blocks, without distance falloff.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.proposed: Marked arrow hits splash other nearby enemies for 50% ranged damage.

spell.archers.entangling_roots.descripti.name: Entangling Roots
spell.archers.entangling_roots.descripti.current: Creates roots in a 6-block radius for 6s, reducing enemy movement speed and jump strength by 60%%. Party allies and owned pets are protected.
spell.archers.entangling_roots.descripti.proposed: Create a 6-block patch of roots for 6s, slowing enemy movement and jumps by 60%.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.name: Improved Entangling Roots
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.current: Entangling Roots cooldown is reduced by 2s, to 10s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.name: Nettle Sprouts
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.current: Every root pulse adds stacking Poison for 5s. The maximum Poison level scales with 20%% of your melee power.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.proposed: Root pulses apply stacking Poison for 5s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.name: Nature's Grasp
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_2_spel.current: Every root pulse immobilizes enemies for 1s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_1_pass.name: Rhythm
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_1_pass.current: +3%% ranged attack speed per stack, up to 15%%. Lasts 4s; hits refresh it.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_1_pass.proposed: Hits build 3% ranged attack speed per stack, up to 15%, for 4s.

spell.archers.barrage.description.name: Barrage
spell.archers.barrage.description.current: Fire 3 accurate arrows, spaced 0.15s apart. Each deals 60%% of normal shot damage.
spell.archers.barrage.description.proposed: Fire 3 arrows that each deal 60% normal shot damage.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.name: Improved Barrage
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.current: Barrage cooldown is reduced by 1s, to 7s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.name: Extensive Barrage
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.current: Barrage fires 1 additional arrow, for 4 total. Each deals 60%% normal shot damage.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.name: Blood Barrage
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.current: Barrage arrow hits heal you for 6%% of your Ranged Damage.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.proposed: Barrage hits heal you for 6% of your ranged power.

spell.archers.spirit_wolf.description.name: Spirit Wolf Pack
spell.archers.spirit_wolf.description.current: Summons 2 Spirit Wolves for 20s. Each has 20 HP plus 40%% of your Ranged Damage, and deals 3 damage plus 15%% of your Ranged Damage per melee hit. Pet bonuses apply.
spell.archers.spirit_wolf.description.proposed: Summon 2 Spirit Wolves for 20s. Your ranged power and pet bonuses make them stronger.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.name: Improved Spirit Wolf
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.current: Spirit Wolf health is 20 HP plus 50%% of your Ranged Damage, instead of 40%%.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.proposed: Spirit Wolves gain extra health equal to 10% of your ranged power.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.name: Leader of the Pack
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.current: Summons 1 additional Spirit Wolf, for 3 total.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.name: Enduring Bond
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_spel.current: Spirit Wolves remain active 10s longer, for 30s total.

spell.archers.rain_of_arrows.description.name: Rain of Arrows
spell.archers.rain_of_arrows.description.current: Rains 40 arrows at 60%% of your Ranged Damage per impact. Arrows fall every 0.25s throughout a random 6-block radius that follows the target, with 2.5-block splash per impact.
spell.archers.rain_of_arrows.description.proposed: Rain 40 arrows around your target. Each deals 60% ranged damage with a small splash.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.name: Torrential Arrows
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.current: Rains 40 arrows every 0.1s across a random 6-block radius. Each impact splashes within 2.5 blocks.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.proposed: Rain of Arrows drops an arrow every 0.1s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.name: Endless Volley
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.current: Add 20 falling arrows, for 60 total, spaced 0.35s apart across a random 6-block radius. Each deals 60%% ranged damage with a 2.5-block splash.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.proposed: Rain of Arrows fires 20 extra arrows, spaced 0.35s apart.

spell.archers.magic_arrow.description.name: Magic Arrows
spell.archers.magic_arrow.description.current: Fire 4 seeking arrows, spaced 0.25s apart. Each deals up to 80%% ranged damage at full charge. Partial charges deal less damage. Arrows seek the nearest enemy within 32 blocks, pass through walls and last 10s. Upgrades improve damage or tracking.
spell.archers.magic_arrow.description.proposed: Fire 4 homing arrows that pass through walls. Each deals up to 80% ranged damage and lasts 10s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.name: Improved Magic Arrows
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.current: Magic Arrows deal 90%% of your Ranged Damage per arrow at full charge instead of 80%%.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.proposed: Magic Arrows deal 90% ranged damage at full charge.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.name: Conjured Arrow
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.current: Fires Magic Arrows upward in a wide spread above you. After 0.5s, they seek the nearest enemy within 32 blocks with medium homing. Hits reveal enemies for 10s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.proposed: Magic Arrows launch above you, turn toward enemies and reveal them for 10s when hit.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.name: Magic Punch
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.current: Magic Arrows deal 100%% of your Ranged Damage per arrow at full charge with Improved Magic Arrows, and gain 150%% extra base knockback.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_4_spel.proposed: Magic Arrows deal 100% ranged damage at full charge and knock enemies back farther.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_pass.name: Supercharge
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_pass.current: Empower your next normal arrow to deal 125%% damage. Lasts 5s; ranged haste is reduced by 25%% until fired.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_pass.proposed: Your next normal arrow deals 25% more damage, but takes longer to draw. Use within 5s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_pass.name: Deflection
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_pass.current: Block the next 3 eligible physical attacks within 10s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.archer_tier_3_pass.proposed: Block the next 3 physical attacks within 10s.

spell.rogues.shock_powder.description.name: Shock Powder
spell.rogues.shock_powder.description.current: Stuns enemies within 5 blocks for 3s, or 1s for high-health mobs and players at 24 HP or more. Improved adds 1s. Mob threshold: 50 HP plus twice your melee power; players below 24 current HP receive the longer stun.
spell.rogues.shock_powder.description.proposed: Stun enemies within 4 blocks for 3s. Tougher targets are stunned for 1s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.name: Improved Shock Powder
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.current: Shock Powder stuns last 1s longer: 2 or 4s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.name: Explosive Powder
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.current: Shock Powder causes a guaranteed explosion dealing 50%% melee damage within 4 blocks, without distance falloff.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.proposed: Shock Powder explodes for 50% melee damage around each enemy hit.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.name: Smoke Screen
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.current: Shock Powder leaves a smoke screen for 8s, granting allies inside 50%% evasion.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.proposed: Shock Powder leaves smoke for 8s, granting you and allies inside 50% evasion.

spell.rogues.slice_and_dice.description.name: Slice & Dice
spell.rogues.slice_and_dice.description.current: For 10s, your next 10 successful melee hits deal 15%% extra melee damage and gently pull enemies toward you. Each hit grants 5%% evasion for 4s, stacking up to 50%%.
spell.rogues.slice_and_dice.description.proposed: Your next 10 melee hits add 15% melee damage, pull enemies closer and build evasion for 4s, up to 50%.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.name: Improved Slice and Dice
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.current: Slice and Dice cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.name: Blades of Fury
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.current: Slice and Dice empowers 4 additional successful hits, for 14 total.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.name: Fleet Footed
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.current: Empowered Slice & Dice hits grant 3%% base movement speed per stack, up to 12 stacks, for 4s. Further hits refresh the duration.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.proposed: Slice & Dice hits build 3% movement speed per stack, up to 36%, for 4s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_1_passi.name: Fracture
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_1_passi.current: Reduce armor by 2 plus 10%% melee power per stack, up to 3 stacks. Lasts 6s; further applications refresh it.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_1_passi.proposed: Shred armor for 6s, stacking 3 times. Your melee power makes it stronger.

spell.rogues.shadow_step.description.name: Shadowstep
spell.rogues.shadow_step.description.current: Teleport behind an enemy within 14 blocks. Disrupt nearby hostile mobs within 4 blocks for 1.5 seconds. Killing an enemy within 4 seconds of a successful Shadowstep resets its cooldown.
spell.rogues.shadow_step.description.proposed: Teleport behind an enemy and briefly disrupt nearby mobs. Kill an enemy within 4s to reset Shadowstep's cooldown.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.name: Cloak of Shadows
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.current: Shadowstep grants immunity to incoming damage for 0.5 seconds.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.proposed: Shadowstep makes you immune to damage for 0.5s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.name: Ambush
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.current: Shadowstep immediately deals 40%% melee damage and applies Blindness I, Weakness I and Slowness I for 2 seconds.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.proposed: Shadowstep deals 40% melee damage and blinds, weakens and slows the enemy for 2s.

spell.rogues.bear_trap.description.name: Bear Trap
spell.rogues.bear_trap.description.current: Place one trap 3 blocks ahead. After arming for 1s it becomes hidden. An enemy within 1 block triggers 40%% dual-melee damage and 1s of root to enemies within 1.5 blocks, plus Slowness I for 3s. Jumping enemies can trigger it.
spell.rogues.bear_trap.description.proposed: Place a hidden trap ahead. It deals 40% dual-wield damage, roots enemies for 1s and slows them for 3s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.name: Improved Bear Trap
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.current: Bear Trap deals 60%% dual-melee damage instead of 40%%.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.name: Serrated Traps
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.current: Apply Bleed for 2.5 seconds. Every 1.25 seconds it deals 2 HP while stationary or 6 HP while moving. Bleed does not scale or stack levels.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.proposed: Bear Trap causes Bleed for 2.5s. Bleed hurts more when the enemy moves.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.name: Extensive Coverage
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.current: Bear Trap affects a 2.25-block radius and activates when enemies enter within 1.5 blocks.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_spell.proposed: Bear Trap triggers from farther away and catches enemies in a larger area.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_passi.name: Sidestep
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_passi.current: +20%% evasion for 2s. Taking damage does not end the buff.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_passi.proposed: Gain 20% evasion for 2s. Taking damage does not remove it.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_passi.name: Opportunist
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_passi.current: After rolling, your next melee hit is guaranteed to critically strike.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_passi.proposed: After rolling, your next melee hit is guaranteed to critically strike.

spell.rogues.vanish.description.name: Vanish
spell.rogues.vanish.description.current: Enter Stealth for 7s with 50%% less base movement speed. Attacking, casting, using items or being hit ends Stealth.
spell.rogues.vanish.description.proposed: Become hidden for 7s but move 50% slower. Attacking, casting, using items or taking a hit ends Stealth.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.name: Improved Vanish
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.current: Vanish reduces base movement speed by 40%% instead of 50%%. Stealth still lasts 7s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.proposed: Vanish slows you by 40% instead of 50%.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.name: Stealth Speed
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.current: Reduce the remaining Vanish movement penalty by another 20%%, leaving 20%% less base movement speed with Improved Vanish.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.proposed: Move faster during Vanish, reducing its remaining movement penalty.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.name: Shadow Stealth
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.current: Attacking, casting spells, using items and taking hits no longer end Vanish. Stealth still expires after 7s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.proposed: Actions and incoming hits no longer end Vanish. Stealth still expires normally.

spell.rogues.mutilate.description.name: Mutilate
spell.rogues.mutilate.description.current: Strike enemies in front of you for 100%% combined dual-wield damage.
spell.rogues.mutilate.description.proposed: Strike enemies in front of you for 100% dual-wield damage.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.name: Crimson Strikes
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.current: Mutilate heals you for 10%% of your melee damage per enemy struck.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.proposed: Mutilate heals you for 10% of your dual-wield power per enemy hit.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.name: Bloody Strikes
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.current: Apply Bleed for 7.5 seconds. Every 1.25 seconds it deals 2 HP while stationary or 6 HP while moving. Bleed does not scale or stack levels.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_4_spell.proposed: Mutilate causes Bleed for 7.5s. Bleed hurts more when the enemy moves.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_passi.name: Cheat Death
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_passi.current: Survive a fatal hit with 3s damage immunity, Speed III and Jump Boost III. Gain +30%% evasion for 6s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_passi.proposed: Survive a fatal enemy hit with 3s immunity, Speed III and Jump Boost III. Gain 30% evasion for 6s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_passi.name: Prepared Counter
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_passi.current: After evading an enemy attack, your next basic melee hit adds 25%% of melee power. One charge; melee skills cannot consume it.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_3_passi.proposed: After evading an enemy attack, your next basic melee hit adds 25% of your melee power.

spell.rogues.throw.description.name: Throw Weapon
spell.rogues.throw.description.current: Throw your weapon for 40%%-80%% melee damage, increasing with charge. Slows enemies for 1s and leaves you weakened for 2s.
spell.rogues.throw.description.proposed: Throw your weapon for 40-80% melee damage, depending on charge. Briefly slow the target and weaken yourself.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.name: Improved Throw Weapon
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.current: Throw Weapon deals 50%%-90%% melee damage, increasing with charge.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.proposed: Throw Weapon deals 50-90% melee damage, depending on charge.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.name: Strong Throw
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.current: Throw Weapon pierces the first enemy and seeks one more with slight homing, hitting up to 2 enemies.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.proposed: Throw Weapon pierces one enemy and seeks a second target.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.name: Head Throw
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.current: Throw Weapon deals 60%%-100%% melee damage, increasing with charge, and stuns for 0.25s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.proposed: Throw Weapon deals 60-100% melee damage and briefly stuns the target.

spell.rogues.throw_net.description.name: Throw Net
spell.rogues.throw_net.description.current: Throw a net for 7.5%%-15%% melee damage, increasing with charge. Roots eligible enemies for 2s and pulls them toward you.
spell.rogues.throw_net.description.proposed: Throw a net that deals 7.5-15% melee damage, roots weaker enemies for 2s and pulls them closer.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.name: Improved Throw Net
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.current: Throw Net gains 6 blocks of charged range, reaching 30 blocks at full charge.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.proposed: Throw Net travels 6 blocks farther when charged.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.name: Bigger Net
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.current: Throw Net also hits enemies within 5 blocks of impact. Each enemy's strength determines whether it can be rooted and pulled.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.proposed: Throw Net catches enemies around its impact.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.name: Multiple Nets
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.current: Throw Net has a 4-second base cooldown instead of 6s. Its root lasts 1.5s instead of 2.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_spe.proposed: Throw Net's cooldown is 2s shorter, but its root is 0.5s shorter.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_1_pas.name: Killing Spree
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_1_pas.current: +2%% melee damage and damage reduction per stack, up to 5 stacks. Lasts 8s; hits refresh it.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_1_pas.proposed: Hits build 2% melee damage and damage reduction per stack, up to 10%, for 8s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_1_pas.name: Endured Vitality
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_1_pas.current: Gain 1 armor plus 6%% melee power and 1 maximum heart per stack, up to 10 stacks. Lasts 8s; hits refresh it. New hearts are healed; refreshing at maximum stacks does not heal.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_1_pas.proposed: Hits grant armor and 1 extra heart per stack for 8s, up to 10 stacks. Your melee power strengthens the armor; only new hearts heal.

spell.rogues.charge.description.name: Wild Charge
spell.rogues.charge.description.current: +50%% base movement speed and +25%% knockback resistance for 2s. Break free of movement impairments and prevent new ones for 2s. Usable while controlled.
spell.rogues.charge.description.proposed: Move 50% faster and resist knockback for 2s. Break free of movement control and resist it for 2s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.name: Improved Wild Charge
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.current: Wild Charge lasts 1s longer: 3s total. Its control protection remains 2s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.proposed: Wild Charge's speed and knockback resistance last 1s longer.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.name: Endurance
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.current: Wild Charge grants full knockback immunity for its entire duration.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.proposed: Wild Charge makes you immune to knockback.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.name: Concussion Blow
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.current: Your next melee hit after Wild Charge stuns for 2s. Use within 4s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.proposed: Your next melee hit after Wild Charge stuns for 2s. Use within 4s.

spell.rogues.shout.description.name: Demoralizing Shout
spell.rogues.shout.description.current: Weaken enemy melee, ranged and magic power by 8%% and reveal them for 6s. Break free of movement impairments and prevent new ones for 3s. Usable while controlled.
spell.rogues.shout.description.proposed: Weaken enemy attack and magic power by 8% and reveal them for 6s. Break free of movement control and resist it for 3s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.name: Improved Shout
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.current: Demoralizing Shout and Battle Shout reach 4 blocks farther: 16 blocks total.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.name: Battle Shout
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.current: Casting Demoralizing Shout grants you and party allies 8%% base melee, ranged and offensive magic power for 6s. Uses the same 12-block radius, or 16 with Improved Shout.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.proposed: Demoralizing Shout grants you and party allies 8% more melee, ranged and magic power for 6s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.name: Challenging Shout
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.current: Demoralizing Shout also deals 10%% melee damage, makes hostile mobs target you and stuns enemies for 0.2s, including bosses.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_spe.proposed: Demoralizing Shout deals 10% melee damage, draws mobs to you and stuns enemies for 0.2s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_pas.name: Momentum
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_pas.current: Ready 5 melee hits for 6s. Each grants +2%% attack and movement speed, up to 10%% each, for 3s. Hits refresh the buffs.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_2_pas.proposed: Your next 5 melee hits build attack and movement speed, up to 10% each for 3s.

spell.rogues.mortal_strike.description.name: Berserker
spell.rogues.mortal_strike.description.current: Each of 5 pulses grants +15%% attack speed, +10%% basic-attack damage, +15%% knockback resistance and +20%% damage taken for 12s. The final pulse fully heals and grants Speed IV for 2s. Expiry fully heals. A fatal hit ends the buff and fully heals, but puts early skills on cooldown and causes Nausea for 10s and stun for 5s.
spell.rogues.mortal_strike.description.proposed: Build attack speed, basic damage and knockback resistance for 12s, but take 20% more damage per stack. Full channel and expiry fully heal you. Full channel grants Speed IV. A fatal hit heals you but ends Berserker, locks early skills and causes stun and Nausea.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.name: Brutality
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.current: +4%% critical chance per Berserker pulse, up to 20%%. Lasts until Berserker ends.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.proposed: Berserker grants 4% critical chance per pulse, up to 20%.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.name: Lethality
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.current: Melee hits restore 1 heart during Berserker. Lose 1 HP every 0.5s, ignoring defenses.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.proposed: Melee hits heal 1 heart during Berserker, but you lose 1 HP every 0.5s.

spell.rogues.last_stand.description.name: Last Stand
spell.rogues.last_stand.description.current: Each pulse adds 20%% maximum health and heals the added health, up to 100%%. Grants brief damage immunity, Regeneration I and knockback immunity.
spell.rogues.last_stand.description.proposed: Channel up to 5 pulses, each adding 20% maximum health and healing the added health. Gain brief immunity, regeneration and knockback immunity.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.name: Improved Last Stand
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.current: Last Stand buffs last 20s instead of 15s. Pulse damage immunity stays at 0.6s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.name: Juggernaut
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.current: Each Last Stand pulse adds 10%% size and 3%% damage reduction, up to 50%% size and 15%% reduction. Lasts 20s with Improved Last Stand; pulses refresh it.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.proposed: Last Stand builds size and damage reduction with each pulse, up to 50% size and 15% reduction.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.name: Sentinel
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.current: +1%% melee damage per direct hit taken during Last Stand, up to 10%%. Refreshes the bonus and Regeneration I for 5s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_4_spe.proposed: Hits taken during Last Stand build melee damage up to 10% and refresh regeneration for 5s.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_pas.name: Enrage
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_pas.current: Gain +4%% melee damage and +8%% size at each health threshold, up to +24%% damage and +48%% size. Bonuses adjust as your health changes.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_pas.proposed: Gain more melee damage and size as your health falls, up to 24% damage and 48% size.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_pas.name: Tenacity
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_pas.current: Gain 6 HP plus 30%% melee power as absorption for 12s. Stun enemies within 5 blocks for 2s.
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.warrior_tier_3_pas.proposed: Gain a shield for 12s that grows with your melee power. Stun nearby enemies for 2s.

spell.wizards.arcane_bolt.description.name: Arcane Bolt
spell.wizards.arcane_bolt.description.current: Shoots a bolt of energy, causing 70%% Arcane damage.
spell.wizards.arcane_bolt.description.proposed: Fire an energy bolt that deals 70% Arcane damage.

spell.wizards.arcane_blast.description.name: Arcane Blast
spell.wizards.arcane_blast.description.current: Blast the target for 80%% Arcane damage and gain an Arcane Charge, up to 3 stacks before upgrades.
spell.wizards.arcane_blast.description.proposed: Deal 80% Arcane damage and gain an Arcane Charge, up to 3 charges.

spell.wizards.fireball.description.name: Fireball
spell.wizards.fireball.description.current: Launch a fireball, dealing 80%% Fire damage and setting the target on fire.
spell.wizards.fireball.description.proposed: Launch a fireball for 80% Fire damage and burn the target.

spell.wizards.fire_scorch.description.name: Scorch
spell.wizards.fire_scorch.description.current: Scorches the target, causing 60%% Fire damage and setting it on fire.
spell.wizards.fire_scorch.description.proposed: Deal 60% Fire damage and set the target on fire.

spell.wizards.fire_blast.description.name: Pyroblast
spell.wizards.fire_blast.description.current: Launch an explosive fireball, dealing up to 100%% Fire damage within 2.5 blocks. Splash damage decreases with distance.
spell.wizards.fire_blast.description.proposed: Fire an explosive fireball for up to 100% Fire damage. Splash damage weakens with distance.

spell.wizards.frostbolt.description.name: Frostbolt
spell.wizards.frostbolt.description.current: Launch a frost projectile that ricochets to 2 additional nearby targets before upgrades, dealing 80%% Frost damage and slowing enemies on impact.
spell.wizards.frostbolt.description.proposed: Fire an ice bolt that slows enemies and jumps to 2 more targets, dealing 80% Frost damage per hit.

spell.wizards.frost_shard.description.name: Frost Shard
spell.wizards.frost_shard.description.current: Launch a frost shard that can bounce off walls, dealing 60%% Frost damage on impact.
spell.wizards.frost_shard.description.proposed: Fire an ice shard that bounces off walls and deals 60% Frost damage.

spell.wizards.frost_shield_burst.descrip.name: Frost Shield Expiry Burst
spell.wizards.frost_shield_burst.descrip.current: Freezes enemies within 5 blocks for 2s when Frost Shield naturally expires. Deals no damage.
spell.wizards.frost_shield_burst.descrip.proposed: Freeze nearby enemies for 2s when Frost Shield expires.

spell.wizards.arcane_barrage_bolt.descri.name: Arcane Emitter Bolt
spell.wizards.arcane_barrage_bolt.descri.current: Emitter projectile dealing 40%% of emitter Arcane damage. Ordinary wand Arcane Bolt is unchanged.
spell.wizards.arcane_barrage_bolt.descri.proposed: Deal 40% of the emitter's Arcane power as damage.

spell.wizards.burst_blink_explosion.desc.name: Burst Blink Explosion
spell.wizards.burst_blink_explosion.desc.current: Deals 50%% Arcane damage within 5 blocks at either Blink position.
spell.wizards.burst_blink_explosion.desc.proposed: Deal 50% Arcane damage around a Blink location.

spell.wizards.elemental_frost_shard.desc.name: Elemental Frost Shard
spell.wizards.elemental_frost_shard.desc.current: Deal 100%% of the elemental's own Frost power as damage.
spell.wizards.elemental_frost_shard.desc.proposed: Deal 100% of the elemental's Frost power as damage.

spell.wizards.elemental_frost_nova.descr.name: Elemental Super Nova
spell.wizards.elemental_frost_nova.descr.current: Deal 180%% of the elemental's own Frost power and freeze enemies for 2s.
spell.wizards.elemental_frost_nova.descr.proposed: Deal 180% of the elemental's Frost power and freeze enemies for 2s.

spell.wizards.legion_frost_nova.descript.name: Legion Super Nova
spell.wizards.legion_frost_nova.descript.current: Deal 180%% of this elemental's own Frost power within 6 blocks, freezing enemies for 0.5s.
spell.wizards.legion_frost_nova.descript.proposed: Deal 180% of the elemental's Frost power and freeze nearby enemies for 0.5s.

spell.wizards.ancient_hydra_breath.descr.name: Ancient Hydra Fire Breath
spell.wizards.ancient_hydra_breath.descr.current: Continuously breathe fire in a 40-degree cone, dealing 24%% of own Fire power per hit. Targets the nearest visible enemy within 12 blocks.
spell.wizards.ancient_hydra_breath.descr.proposed: Breathe fire at nearby enemies, dealing 24% of the hydra's Fire power per hit.

spell.wizards.hydra_fireball.description.name: Hydra Fireball
spell.wizards.hydra_fireball.description.current: Deal 55%% of the hydra's own Fire power.
spell.wizards.hydra_fireball.description.proposed: Deal 55% of the hydra's Fire power.

spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.name: Explosive Powder
spell.skill_tree_rpgs.rogue_tier_2_spell.current: Companion marker; adds no extra stun duration.
